test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among of the following languages, is not a part of Eighth Schedule of Indian Constitution? (As of March 2022)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthani **is **not **part of the **eight schedule of the Constitution.**
 
• The 71st Amendment Act, 1992 amended the **8th Schedule **of the Constitution to incorporate **Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali Languages** within the 8th Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• The constitutional provision relating to the eighth schedule occur in** articles 344(1)** and** 351 of the constitution**. 
 
• The eighth schedule of the Indian constitution contains a listing of** twenty-two scheduled languages**. 
 
• **Bodo,Dogri,maithili and santhal** languages are added by **92nd, Amendment,2003**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipu**r- Manipur ​ language added in **71st amendment act, 1992**.
 
• **Nepali**- The Nepali language added in** 71st amendment act, 1992**.
 
• **Konkani**- The Konkani language added in **71st amendment act, 1992**.
